# ATFGraph vNext reference

> Generated reference for ATFGraph vNext: the HTTP contract in contracts/openapi-v2.json, the schemas it defines, the example agent nodes in this repository and developer usage guides.

Generated by scripts/generate-reference.py from contracts/openapi-v2.json: 162 operations, 280 schemas, 39 examples, 41 documents. Every page below is part of this site at https://rimon-fc.github.io/atfgraph.

## Overview
- [Overview](https://rimon-fc.github.io/atfgraph/index.html)

## API
- [Access operations](https://rimon-fc.github.io/atfgraph/api/access.html): Access policies and connector grants: who may start which traversals, and which external connectors a namespace may reach. Server authorization is authoritative; these operations edit the rules it enforces.
- [Admin operations](https://rimon-fc.github.io/atfgraph/api/admin.html): Registering agent node definitions. Registration is immutable per version.
- [Approvals operations](https://rimon-fc.github.io/atfgraph/api/approvals.html): Requesting a decision from a human or another principal while a traverser waits.
- [Artifacts operations](https://rimon-fc.github.io/atfgraph/api/artifacts.html): Files a traverser produced or consumed: upload, list, download and delete them by traverser.
- [Auth operations](https://rimon-fc.github.io/atfgraph/api/auth.html)
- [Budgets operations](https://rimon-fc.github.io/atfgraph/api/budgets.html)
- [Checkpoints operations](https://rimon-fc.github.io/atfgraph/api/checkpoints.html): Named, revisioned state a live traverser writes and reads back.
- [Credentials operations](https://rimon-fc.github.io/atfgraph/api/credentials.html): Node identity enrolment, credential issuance and verification, revocation and the node tag ledger. Keys stay on the graph server; nothing here hands out private material.
- [Discovery operations](https://rimon-fc.github.io/atfgraph/api/discovery.html): Reading the server description, the registered agent nodes and their capabilities, and the agent-resource-discovery publications and search under /api/v2/ard.
- [Emitters operations](https://rimon-fc.github.io/atfgraph/api/emitters.html): Scheduled and event-driven sources that start traversers, plus their delivery log.
- [Evaluations operations](https://rimon-fc.github.io/atfgraph/api/evaluations.html)
- [Events operations](https://rimon-fc.github.io/atfgraph/api/events.html): The durable event log of a traverser, as a snapshot or as a stream.
- [Health operations](https://rimon-fc.github.io/atfgraph/api/health.html): Unauthenticated liveness of the graph server.
- [Identity operations](https://rimon-fc.github.io/atfgraph/api/identity.html): Node identities, signed paths and proof verification.
- [API reference](https://rimon-fc.github.io/atfgraph/api/index.html)
- [Knowledge operations](https://rimon-fc.github.io/atfgraph/api/knowledge.html): Document knowledge per scope: put, list, get, delete, lexical BM25 search with citations, and per-scope statistics.
- [Memory operations](https://rimon-fc.github.io/atfgraph/api/memory.html): Reading and writing the session, actor, workflow and global memory scopes.
- [Observability operations](https://rimon-fc.github.io/atfgraph/api/observability.html): What the server knows about running work: usage accounting, node logs, traverser metadata, the observability webhook, server-wide stats and model-endpoint health.
- [Retention operations](https://rimon-fc.github.io/atfgraph/api/retention.html): Preview and apply pruning of old traversers, events and logs.
- [RuntimeSettings operations](https://rimon-fc.github.io/atfgraph/api/runtimesettings.html): Stored runtime documents per namespace: list, read, write and delete a key, then apply it to the running process. Saving a document and applying it are separate steps.
- [Sessions operations](https://rimon-fc.github.io/atfgraph/api/sessions.html): Creating sessions and binding a worker task to one.
- [Traversers operations](https://rimon-fc.github.io/atfgraph/api/traversers.html): Submitting traversers, listing them with status, time-window and cursor paging, reading one traverser and its path, cancelling and restarting.
- [Worker operations](https://rimon-fc.github.io/atfgraph/api/worker.html): The outbound worker protocol: enrol, claim, renew, report, complete, drain; and the fleet view of every enrolled worker.
